title: Contextual Phase-Aware Speech Enhancement under Severe Noise and Distribution Shift: Reproducibility Package
description: Reproducibility package for a controlled A0-A5 speech-enhancement ablation study evaluated on VoiceBank+DEMAND and an 18,340-case LibriSpeech+DNS external low-SNR stress test. The archival package contains publication notebooks, OOD evaluation utilities, derived results, and selected best checkpoints. Raw third-party speech/noise datasets are not redistributed.
